title: Vector Fourier granularity
statement: A function $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ is vector Fourier granular with parameter $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$ if the function on the sign cube induced by $f$ is Fourier granular with parameter $\varepsilon$.
